llm_hartree_fock_calculation.notes: LLM outputs were pre-generated and stored in YAML scoring data. We analyze the human-annotated scores rather than re-running the LLM.

paper_extraction.notes: Paper information extraction was performed by GPT-4 and results are stored in the YAML. We analyze extraction accuracy through placeholder-level scoring.

self_consistent_iteration.notes: The benchmark covers analytic HF derivations only. Self-consistent numerical iteration is outside scope.

fallbacks.notes: All required capabilities are available. The analysis uses pre-computed LLM outputs and human scores, which are provided in the workspace.
